BSL is taking initiative for carbon neutrality in its new plant at Kharkhauda applicable in plant construction, transportation system and usage of green energy

India continues to stand out as one of the world's fastest growing major economies, well positioned to sustain this momentum supported by infrastructure spending, services strength, and steady manufacturing activity creating a structurally attractive environment for engineering-intensive companies.
Over the next decade, electric vehicle segment growth will lead to newer verticals and opportunities for auto component manufacturers.
India is one of the few regions where both traditional ICE vehicles and EVs are expected to grow well in the next 3-5 years.

Uncertainties exist with respect to the interpretation of complex tax regulations, changes in tax laws, and the amount and timing of future taxable income.
The cost of defined benefit plans (i.e., Gratuity benefit) is determined using actuarial valuations... highly sensitive to changes in these assumptions.

When the fair value of financial assets and financial liabilities recorded in the balance sheet cannot be measured based on quoted prices in active markets, their fair value is measured using valuation techniques... Changes in assumptions about these factors could affect the reported fair value of financial instruments.
The impairment provisions of financial assets are based on assumptions about risk of default and expected loss rates.

Impairment exists when the carrying value of an asset or cash generating unit exceeds its recoverable amount... The recoverable amount is sensitive to the discount rate used for the DCF model as well as the expected future cash-inflows and the growth rate used for extrapolation purposes.

The Company cannot readily determine the interest rate implicit in the lease, therefore its incremental borrowing rate (IBR) to measure lease liability... requires estimates when no observable rates are available.
